company.name: Simplex
company.shortDescription: Simplex is an EMI licensed Fintech company providing fraudless payment processing solutions to online merchants
company.description:
Fully regulated as a financial institution, Simplex processes credit card payments with a 100% fraud protection guarantee – in case of a fraud chargeback, the merchant gets paid by Simplex. 
Utilizing its cutting-edge fraud prevention solution and AI technology, Simplex blocks fraudulent users and allows legitimate users to complete payments, thereby, increasing conversion rates and enabling merchants to focus on their business growth. In today's banking echo-system Crypto-related businesses are underserved. Simplex enables personal individuals and businesses to get an EU IBAN account for their banking activity having all the necessary payment account functions

productsAndServices.description: A platform enabling individuals and businesses to buy cryptocurrencies instantly using various fiat payment methods with fraud prevention and zero chargeback risk.
productsAndServices.name: Fiat-to-Crypto Payment Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables users to sell cryptocurrencies and withdraw funds globally using personal IBANs and supports high transaction volumes with low fees.
productsAndServices.name: Crypto Selling Service

productsAndServices.description: Proprietary AI-driven tools that ensure 100% fraudless transactions and protect merchants from chargebacks during fiat-to-crypto payments.
productsAndServices.name: Fraud and Risk Management Tools

productsAndServices.description: Flexible APIs and customizable user interfaces that enable fast and seamless integration of Simplex’s payment processing services into partner platforms.
productsAndServices.name: API and Integration Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Support for a wide range of payment methods including credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, ACH, and over 570 alternative payment options worldwide.
productsAndServices.name: Global Payment Method Support
